description: CRITICAL MACRO AUTOMATION STATE FIXES: Resolved 2 critical macro automation state issues - (1) Fixed options chain table stale date problem where wrong expiration data displayed during macro execution by implementing immediate ref updates when Step 1 is skipped, (2) Fixed macro stalling after Step 1 where Steps 3-4 skipped with 'Prerequisites not met' when user selected non-default expiration dates by enhancing prerequisites validation with expiration state consistency checks. Enhanced state synchronization between UI and macro execution context with robust validation logic. All fixes validated with 100% success rate across multiple test scenarios and both NVDA/SPY tabs. Production-ready implementation with excellent code quality.
